thread:
Aisha K: Quick heads-up — I pushed a tiny wording PR and it's merged, but we have 3 docs PRs blocking the scheduled content deploy at 2025-06-10 11:30 PT. Can someone pick up reviews? PRs: #2194 (sdk-snippets), #2201 (migration guide), #2203 (link fix).

Jon Reyes: I can take #2194 and #2201. Busy 11:00-11:20 though. :thumbsup:

Priya Nair: I'll look at #2203 and run the docs preview now. Any known failing links?

docs-bot: Build 482 for branch docs/pr-2201 failed — 1 broken link: /guides/migrations#model-pin -> 404. CI log: https://ci.example/482

Tom S: I can help if previews pass. Priya, if you rerun preview for #2201, can you paste the preview URL?

Priya Nair: reran with `/ci rerun 482` — new build 488 succeeded. Preview: https://deploy-preview-488.docs.redwood.ai/guides/migrations :sparkles:

Aisha K: Amazing — Jon, if you can do a quick content check on migration steps and confirm the model pin wording is accurate, we can merge before the window. Also can we note reviewer rotation so we don't end up with coverage gaps next week?

Jon Reyes: On it. Quick note for #2194 (SDK snippets): run `yarn doc-preview --pr 2194` locally if CI preview stalls — caches sometimes cause the snippet bundle to mismatch. I fixed an indentation issue in the branch.

Priya Nair: Merged #2203 (link fix) — thanks. :tada:

Jon Reyes: Reviewed #2201 — minor nit on step ordering, pushed a tiny commit. Ready for final pass.

Aisha K: I'll do final pass on #2194 in ~10m and merge after green CI. If anyone's on rotation, please add yourself to the docs-reviewer-rotation sheet so we can plan the next week's window.

docs-bot: Deploy job queued for scheduled docs deploy window at 2025-06-10T18:30:00Z.

Tom S: 👍 If anything blocks, ping me and I can do an emergency handoff during the deploy window.

Aisha K: Thanks all — feeling good about this batch.
